mappings.name: Screen Studio
mappings.zh_note: 分開確認自動縮放、游標、字幕與分享；基本錄影不等於完整取代。
mappings.en_note: Check zoom, cursor effects, captions and sharing separately.

mappings.name: Camtasia
mappings.zh_note: 錄影與後製需求需分開比較。
mappings.en_note: Compare recording and editing requirements separately.

mappings.name: Snagit / CleanShot X
mappings.zh_note: OCR、長截圖與雲端分享要另外查證。
mappings.en_note: Verify OCR, scrolling capture and sharing independently.

mappings.name: Loom
mappings.zh_note: 本機錄影不能當成已有團隊分享與觀看分析。
mappings.en_note: Local recording does not establish team sharing or viewing analytics.

mappings.name: Microsoft Word
mappings.zh_note: 以實際文件測試；套裝訂閱未取消不計節省。
mappings.en_note: Test real files; do not count savings while a required suite remains subscribed.

mappings.name: Microsoft Excel
mappings.zh_note: 巨集、外部資料與複雜公式需確認。
mappings.en_note: Verify macros, external data and complex formulas.

mappings.name: Microsoft PowerPoint
mappings.zh_note: 確認字型、動畫與影片嵌入。
mappings.en_note: Verify fonts, animations and embedded video.

mappings.name: Adobe Acrobat
mappings.zh_note: 依拆合頁面、改正文、簽章分開評估。
mappings.en_note: Separate page operations, text editing and signatures.

mappings.name: Adobe Photoshop
mappings.zh_note: 修圖與繪畫分開；不保證 PSD 與外掛互通。
mappings.en_note: Separate retouching from painting; PSD/plugin compatibility is not guaranteed.

mappings.name: Adobe Premiere Pro
mappings.zh_note: 先確認交付格式與團隊專案依賴。
mappings.en_note: Check delivery formats and team project dependencies.

mappings.name: Adobe Audition
mappings.zh_note: 只對基礎錄音剪輯推薦候選。
mappings.en_note: Candidates cover basic audio editing, not every DAW workflow.

mappings.name: Adobe After Effects
mappings.zh_note: 僅為特定合成或動畫用途候選，不是完整替代。
mappings.en_note: Partial compositing/animation candidates, not complete replacements.

mappings.name: Paid voice typing
mappings.zh_note: 確認繁中、專有名詞、本機模型與官方成品價格。
mappings.en_note: Check Chinese terminology, local models and official binary pricing.

mappings.name: Paid transcription
mappings.zh_note: 逐字稿、會議紀錄與文字剪輯是不同功能。
mappings.en_note: Transcription, meeting notes and text-based editing are different features.
